notes.title: Asked SBI for provisional letter
notes.text: You asked your branch yesterday for an in-principle sanction letter, so the visa file has proof of funds before the full sanction lands. That is two things now from the same branch, on two different dates. - The branch landline is in her signature, and a call will be quicker than this thread.

notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at TLS Contact
notes.title: France-Visas account started
notes.text: France-Visas wrote to you on Saturday evening to confirm the address on your new account. That is one of the two logins Fitria asked for. - TLS Contact is the other, and that one takes a phone call rather than the website.

notes.title: Wednesday is still unconfirmed
notes.text: Fitria offered Wednesday at 10am and you have not written back. Your originals are still with the courier, and she needs them in your hand on the day. - A line to her today confirms it, and you can still move it if the parcel is late.
